messages:
Melissa (CS): FYI Zephyr Apps says they didn't see the $50,000 manual credit Sales applied yesterday. Sales provided PO# ZPH-2026-991 and promo code ZEPNOV2026. Billing UI still shows outstanding invoice and their usage hasn't been reduced. Also they reported 502s hitting /v1/generate around the same time. Can Finance confirm ledger/invoice state?

Raj (Sales): I created the adjustment on our side and attached the PO to the billing ticket. We used promo ZEPNOV2026 and added note 'contract promo Q4' in CRM. Screenshot sent via email to billing.

Anne AM: Customer is asking for a formal PO note on the final invoice. They won't accept 'pending' status — need manual ledger entry + invoice reissue.

BillingBot: Ticket #BILL-7482 created for manual credit processing. Current SLA: 2 business days.

Melissa (CS): We need faster — this is enterprise with active SLA. Can we expedite? Also the customer saw intermittent 502/504s around 2026-03-15 14:22 UTC. Repro steps they provided: 1) 10 concurrent POSTs to /v1/generate 2) model redwood-7b 3) timeout 30s. Success rate dropped to ~60%.

Ivan (Eng): Can you paste a curl of the failing request + response headers and the x-request-id? Also which region (us-west-2 or eu-west-1)?

Melissa (CS): Curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":128}'
Response: 502 Bad Gateway, x-request-id: rq_08f7e3f2, date: 2026-03-15T14:22:41Z. Region: us-west-2.

Ivan (Eng): Thanks. I'll trace rq_08f7e3f2 in runtime logs. On the billing side — sometimes the ledger entry exists but invoice caching prevents immediate reflection. @Katie (Finance) can you check ledger vs invoice for PO ZPH-2026-991?

Katie (Finance): Pulling ledger now. Quick check: manual credit record exists but 'apply_to_invoice' flag is false. That would leave invoice unchanged. I can flip it to true but need the exact PO note string to include on invoice: 'Manual credit per PO ZPH-2026-991 for contract promo ZEPNOV2026'. Confirm? Once flipped I'll trigger invoice re-calc.

Raj (Sales): Confirm — include that exact string. CRM has the PO attachment.

Anne AM: Customer expects an emailed confirmation once invoice is updated. Melissa, can you follow up and cc finance?

Melissa (CS): Will do. Katie, please post the internal ledger id after you flip the flag so I can track.

BillingBot: Action logged: Finance user katie_finance updated credit apply flag on credit id cr_54219. Invoice recalculation queued. Estimated update: 30 minutes.

Katie (Finance): Done. Credit id cr_54219, invoice INV-8842 queued for recalculation. ETA ~28 minutes. I'll notify when complete and email PO note to customer.

Melissa (CS): Thanks all. I'll follow up with the customer and keep this thread updated. Marking for priority. :thumbsup:

Ivan (Eng): Update on 502: traced rq_08f7e3f2 — runtime worker redwood-runtime-3 returned 502 due to open sockets exhaustion during a burst of concurrent requests. Rolled a soft limit on max concurrent sockets per worker and started a canary rollout to us-west-2. Monitoring error-rate for drop.

Anne AM: Customer emailed back — they appreciate the quick turnaround and asked that the PO note appear on the final invoice. Melissa, please attach BillingBot confirmation once invoice updates.

BillingBot: Invoice INV-8842 status UPDATED -> credit_applied. Final amount reduced by $50,000. Confirmation email sent to anne@zephyrapp.com by katie_finance.

Melissa (CS): Closing the loop with the customer now and attaching BillingBot confirmation. Filing a short incident summary for the 502s in #eng-runtime and opening a follow-up with Sales to validate apply_to_invoice checkbox on future manual credits. Thread will remain open for any further follow-ups.
